summary: Immatics N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held June 18, 2026. Shareholders approved routine agenda items including adoption of 2025 statutory accounts, discharge of directors, reappointment of three directors, extension of board authorization to acquire shares, approval of the 2026 stock option and incentive plan, and appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of shareholder meeting results, not a special situation disclosure. No transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review is described. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements.
